name: imospot
description: Search real-estate listings in Romania on Imospot.ro: apartments, houses, land and commercial space for sale or rent, with full listing details and asking prices by neighborhood.

interface.longDescription: Find homes in Romania with Imospot.ro, a real-estate marketplace with listings from agencies and private owners and no duplicate listings. Search apartments, houses, land, offices and warehouses for sale or for rent by city, neighborhood, street, number of rooms, price, area, layout and amenities (yard, garage, parking). Open the full details of any listing (characteristics, amenities, description, photos) and compare median asking prices and price per m² between the neighborhoods of a city. Every result links to the listing page on imospot.ro, where you can call or message the seller. Read-only: no account needed, and no personal data is collected.
defaultPrompt: Find a 2-room apartment for sale in Cluj-Napoca under €120,000
Which neighborhoods in Bucharest are cheapest to rent a 2-room apartment?
Show me houses with a yard for sale near Sibiu

positive.description: Search apartments for sale with rooms and budget
positive.prompt: Find a 2-room apartment for sale in Sibiu under 100,000 euros.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings with city Sibiu, transaction sale, property_type apartment, rooms [2], price_max 100000; returns the total number of matches and up to 10 listings with price, area, location and a link to each listing on imospot.ro.

positive.description: Search rentals in a specific neighborhood
positive.prompt: I need a 2 or 3-room apartment to rent in Floreasca, Bucharest.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings with city București (or Bucharest), neighborhood Floreasca, transaction rent, property_type apartment, rooms [2,3]; lists matching rentals with monthly price, area and links to imospot.ro.

positive.description: Open the details of one listing
positive.prompt: Find houses with a yard for sale in Brașov, then tell me everything about the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings (city Brașov, transaction sale, property_type house, amenities [curte]), then get_listing with the id of the first result; summarizes characteristics, amenities, description and photos, and gives the listing link for contacting the seller.

positive.prompt: Which neighborhoods in Cluj-Napoca are the cheapest to rent a 2-room apartment?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls neighborhood_prices with city Cluj-Napoca, transaction rent, rooms 2, order cheapest; returns a ranking of neighborhoods with median monthly rent and median price per m², noting these are asking prices.

positive.description: Search land by area and price, sorted by price
positive.prompt: Show me the cheapest plots of land for sale in Sibiu, at least 500 square meters.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_listings with city Sibiu, transaction sale, property_type land, area_min 500, sort price_asc; lists plots from the cheapest, with plot area, price and links.

negative.description: Real estate outside Romania and Moldova
negative.prompt: Find me an apartment to rent in Paris.
Write a poem about the sea.
Give me the phone numbers of all real-estate agents in Bucharest.

publication.release_notes: First release: search_listings, get_listing and neighborhood_prices for real-estate listings in Romania and the Republic of Moldova.
